items.label: Identification and traceability of outputs
items.intent: Each delivered lot can be traced back through production to the material and process records that justify its conformity.
items.question: Establish by tracing sampled shipped lots backwards that identification is maintained and traceability can actually be reconstructed.
items.ncPattern: Identifier changes between operations with no linking record
items.findingStem: Objective evidence shows the requirement is not met: {evidence}. The intent of clause 8.5.2 is not met.

items.label: Measuring equipment calibrated at defined intervals against traceable standards
items.intent: Equipment used to accept product is demonstrably accurate at the time it is used, because it is calibrated within its interval against standards that trace to national or international references.
items.question: Establish that equipment in use was within its calibration interval when used and that calibration is traceable.
items.ncPattern: Register is updated but usage is not checked against it
items.findingStem: Objective evidence shows the requirement is not met: {evidence}. The intent of clause 7.1.5.2 is not met.

items.label: Verification of externally provided processes and products
items.intent: The organization decides, and then actually performs, the verification needed to be confident that what an external provider supplies meets requirements.
items.question: Establish that defined receiving verification is performed and recorded for outsourced special-process product (anodize).
items.ncPattern: Certificate held only in a portal not under the organization’s retention control
items.findingStem: Objective evidence shows the requirement is not met: {evidence}. The intent of clause 8.4.2 is not met.

items.label: Effectiveness of actions taken to acquire competence
items.intent: When the organization acts to close a competence gap, it confirms the action worked, using a method it defines, rather than assuming completion equals competence.
items.question: Establish that effectiveness of competence actions is evaluated against defined criteria — by whatever method the organization uses.
evidence: Evaluation results (in whatever form the organization uses)
items.ncPattern: Completion recorded but effectiveness never judged
items.findingStem: Objective evidence shows the requirement is not met: {evidence}. The intent of clause 7.2 is not met.

items.label: Validation and control of special processes
items.intent: Where output cannot be fully verified afterwards, the process itself is proven capable, its equipment and people are qualified, and it is kept in control and revalidated.
items.question: Establish that the in-house heat-treat process is validated and that equipment and personnel qualification are current.
items.findingStem: Objective evidence shows the requirement is not met: {evidence}. The intent of clause 8.5.1.2 is not met.
